perf.summary: Same as GridNeighbors4: replace managed static int[] tables with inline constants / stackalloc to be Burst-safe and drop per-access bounds checks.
perf.currentCost: 8 iterations each load DR[d] and DC[d] from managed static int[] arrays — Burst-incompatible managed references, bounds-checked loads, static-field indirection; violates house no-managed-array rule.
perf.proposedChange: Remove DR/DC arrays; either stackalloc the 8 offsets locally or fully unroll the 8 neighbor checks with literal offsets. Center cell is skipped by construction so no extra branch needed.
perf.rationale: Eliminates managed access (Burst can compile), removes 16 array bounds checks per call, removes static indirection, enables constant folding and removes loop overhead via unrolling.
perf.risk: None to semantics; preserve the same 8-direction emission order so packed output order is unchanged.
